summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FieldCommand SaaS application. Backend APIs are working excellently (94.7% success rate), but frontend has critical React SelectItem component errors causing UI crashes.

minor_issues.issue: Test credentials (test@fieldcommand.fr) don't exist in database
minor_issues.impact: Cannot test login flow with provided credentials

critical_bugs.issue: SelectItem components missing required value prop, causing React runtime errors
critical_bugs.error_message: A <SelectItem /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string
critical_bugs.impact: UI crashes when using dropdown selects, prevents devis creation and other forms

ui_bugs.issue: Element detachment during navigation causing click timeouts
ui_bugs.symptoms: Intermittent navigation failures, elements becoming detached from DOM

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix SelectItem components throughout the application by ensuring all SelectItem elements have proper value props. This is preventing dropdown functionality and causing React runtime errors. The error occurs in client selection dropdowns, type selectors, and other form elements. Without this fix, users cannot complete key workflows like creating devis or selecting options in forms.
